description: AVIATION BATTLES ONLY (pick AVIATION on the main menu). Heavy bombers: the B-17 Flying Fortress, B-52H Stratofortress, B-1B Lancer and B-2A Spirit for Vanguard; the Avro Lancaster, Tu-95MS Bear, Tu-22M3 Backfire and Tu-160 Blackjack for Onyx. The jet bombers carry cruise missiles (JASSM, Kh-101, Kh-22) that lock on from two kilometres, the swing-wing ones sweep their wings back as they speed up, and the B-2 is stealthy. The bots fire their cruise missiles from a distance before going in with the bombs. Fly with mouse aim or the joystick (FLIGHT CONTROLS in the settings). Bots fly bombing runs over the flags.
